messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: hotfix v2.3.1 -> eu-west1. Reason: occasional tokenizer OOM on long inputs (seen in SRE alert). Change window: immediate. Requires expedited approvals from eng-release + oncall within 15m. Rollback criteria: >=5% 5xx or p95 latency +200ms.

maya: tagging this for fast-track. can we do a 5% canary for 10m then ramp?

sam: pinging infra — autoscaler spike looks ok but GPUs in eu-west1 are near capacity; prefer pin to single host pool. @maya can we pin node pool b?

oliver: +1 for expedited, provided we pin. Also request we attach changelog snippet and SHA.

maya: yes pin to pool-b and image sha 7a3b2f4. Canary 5% for 10m, then 25% for 5m if stable, then 100%.

tina: I've prepared the release note blurb: "Hotfix: fixed tokenizer OOM on long sequences; improves stability for long-context requests." Will push to release-notes once deploy completes.

oncall-bot: recent errors: 42 spikes last 6h, sample trace: `tokenize() -> mem alloc fail at 1.2GB` . Current p95 latency 120ms, error rate 0.6%.

sam: ok, ops confirms pool-b has 2 spare nodes, pin approved. We should also set automatic rollback if error rate exceeds threshold.

maya: deploy plan in runbook:
```
- tag image: 7a3b2f4
- pin to pool-b
- canary: 5% for 10m, monitor error-rate & p95
- ramp to 25% for 5m if ok
- full roll at 100%
- rollback: immediate to previous image if >5% errors or p95 +200ms
```

oliver: approved. i'm +1. setting my approval in the deploy bot. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: oliver. Need one more approval from eng-release or oncall to proceed.

sam: oncall (tina?) can you give final green if monitoring hooks present?

maya: oncall, can you stand by to watch canary dashboards and trigger rollback if needed?

oncall-bot: metrics dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/eu1/tokenizer-cpu. Alerting rules present for error-rate and p95.

tina: standing by. I approve expedited deploy. I'll monitor and call rollback if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: All approvals satisfied. Starting canary deploy: v2.3.1 -> eu-west1, image 7a3b2f4, canary 5%. Canary window started.

maya: monitoring logs... no 5xx so far. p95 unchanged.

oncall-bot: canary metrics t+5m: error-rate 0.2%, p95 +10ms. No regressions.

sam: infra note: GPU pool-b spindown disabled for 20m.

oliver: looks good. continue to 25%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% initiated.

oncall-bot: ramp t+3m: error-rate 0.25%, p95 +15ms. All checks passing.

maya: ramping to full.

deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated. Finalizing.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: v2.3.1 -> eu-west1, image 7a3b2f4. No rollback triggered.

tina: confirmed stable at 30m post-deploy. Closing fast-track. Will update incident log with notes and add release note entry.

maya: thanks everyone. follow-up: schedule perf regression run tomorrow to ensure no subtle perf cost.

oliver: noted. :rocket:
